description:
In a world where optimal health and well-being are highly valued, NutriMagic has quickly risen as a trusted brand in the natural supplements market. Founded in 2021 under Herbamax LLC in the USA, NutriMagic is dedicated to applying the power of nature into providing premium quality supplements that promote holistic wellness.

One of the flagship products of NutriMagic is the Dead Sea Magnesium, a patented high-absorption formula that sets it apart from other magnesium supplements in the market. NutriMagic Magnesium is sourced purely from the Dead Sea in Israel, ensuring a natural and high-quality source of this essential mineral. What makes it unique is its superior absorption rate, thanks to its Patented Elemental Magnesium Oxide-Monohydrate formula, which provides a remarkable 139% of the recommended daily value (RDV) in just one capsule. This means that with NutriMagic Magnesium, there's no need to gulp down a meal of multiple capsules, as just one capsule can provide a significant amount of magnesium for your daily needs. This is in contrast to many other big brands that may require up to 12 capsules to actually reach a 100% daily value of Magnesium. This supplement can be found on the NutriMagic website as well as Amazon.com, get yours today!

In addition to its high absorption formula, NutriMagic Magnesium is also vegan, kosher, non-GMO, soy and dairy-free, and does not contain any harmful chemicals. This makes it a safe and suitable option for a wide range of individuals with varying dietary preferences and restrictions. With 60 capsules per bottle, NutriMagic Magnesium provides a 2-month supply, making it convenient and cost-effective for daily use.

Another notable product in the NutriMagic lineup is the Kids Brain Booster+. This Saffron-based nootropic supplement is specially formulated to support brain health in children, aiding focus, attention, concentration, creativity, calmness, and mood elevation. What sets Kids Brain Booster+ apart, besides having Saffron “The Sunshine Spice” as the main ingredient that makes it work the way it does, is that it is also a Multivitamin, containing essential Vitamins & Minerals such as D3, B6, B12, and Zinc to support overall well-being. The gummies are caffeine-free and come in a delicious Fruit flavor (More flavors coming soon) and convenient gummy form, making it easy for kids to consume. With a recommended dosage of 2 gummies daily, preferably in the morning, and allowing at least 2 weeks for results to show, Kids Brain Booster+ offers a natural and comprehensive solution for parents who want to support their children's cognitive health. Besides www.nutri-magic.com, you can purchase it on Amazon.com!

One of the key factors that sets NutriMagic apart is its commitment to quality and safety. All NutriMagic supplements are GMP certified and undergo rigorous testing to ensure purity, potency, and effectiveness. The brand takes pride in using natural, pure and high-quality ingredients that are free from harmful chemicals, making its products safe for long-term use.

Furthermore, NutriMagic is dedicated to sustainability and eco-conscious practices. The brand strives to minimize its environmental impact by using recyclable packaging and promoting sustainable sourcing and manufacturing processes.

Customer reviews of NutriMagic supplements have been overwhelmingly positive, with many users reporting improved well-being, increased energy, and enhanced cognitive function. Customers appreciate the high absorption rate, convenience of one-capsule daily dosing, and the vegan, kosher, non-GMO, soy and dairy-free formulations that cater to diverse dietary needs and health concerns. Parents and Teachers of kids that have been using the Kids Brain Booster+ daily report drastic improvements in behaviour and learning abilities both in school and at home.

In conclusion, NutriMagic is a natural supplements brand that is committed to unlocking the magic of nutrition for optimal health and wellness. With its premium quality products, including the high-absorption Dead Sea Magnesium and Kids Brain Booster+ for children, NutriMagic offers effective and safe solutions for individuals seeking natural ways to support their health goals. With a focus on quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction, NutriMagic has quickly gained recognition as a trusted brand in the natural supplements market! Give them a try yourself – Go to www.Nutri-Magic.com or search for NutriMagic products on Amazon.com today.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: emmanuel@nutri-magic.com.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to emmanuel@nutri-magic.com for support.
